# ARTHRITIS ASSOCIATED WITH LYME DISEASE

Arthritis is a common manifestation of late-stage Lyme Disease. Consult Infectious Diseases or Rheumatology if symptoms persist or recur after completing antimicrobial treatment.

References:

- Lantos et al., Clinical Infectious Diseases, 2021, 72(1):e1-e48
- Mandell Chapter: Lyme Disease (Lyme Borreliosis) Due to Borrelia burgdorferi
- Sanchez et al., JAMA (2016) 315.16
- Sanford keyword: Lyme Disease, Arthritis
- Up-to-date article: Musculoskeletal manifestations of Lyme disease
Therapy:
## Treatment

Preferred:

Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h ($) [DI] for 28 days
For pregnant patients or those with contraindications to doxycycline:
Amoxicillin 500 mg PO q8h ($) [R] for 28 days
